title: AI for Good: Why We Lack It & What You Think #shorts
description: A survey revealed the top reason we lack AI for good: the wrong people making decisions. True impact starts with solving a problem, not just chasing AI trends. Is your approach right? #AIforGood #ProblemSolving #DecisionMaking #TechEthics

So, one of them was, "Monetize quickly enough." Two was, "Nobody actually cares." Three was, "Wrong people making decisions." And four is, "We pretend it's too complex." I have two questions.
